exposure: antecedents of a positive postpartum depression screen (e.g., adverse neonatal outcomes)
outcome: completed referrals for mental health services
rate of perinatal mood disorder diagnoses
diagnosis of depressive disorder in the peripartum period
cohort: The study included 25,425 women undergoing universal postpartum depression screening with deliveries from January 2017 to December 2019, who were compared to a historic cohort from the same population from June 2008 to March 2010.
finding: Utilization of mental health services following a positive depression screen more than doubled (57% vs 22%) after the implementation of colocated services compared to historically separated services.
